name: Dynamic Metal Price Calculator
author: Aolo Software

sections.description:
Dynamic Metal Price Calculator empowers WooCommerce store owners to automate pricing for jewellery products using formula-based computations.
No more manual updates — your prices adjust instantly with every rate change.

🔥 Watch the full video tutorial here:
👉 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xxxxxxxxxxx

💡 Key Features

  • Admin Metal Dashboard — Set daily gold/silver prices directly from the backend.
  • Auto Karat Calculation — Automatically computes derived karat prices:
    • 22K = gold rate × 93%
    • 20K = gold rate × 85.5%
    • 18K = gold rate × 78%
    • These values are editable directly in admin.
  • Per-Product Metal Settings
    • Metal Type (Gold, Silver, or Custom)
    • Base Price (optional)
    • Weight (g)
    • Wastage (%)
    • Making Charge (per g)
    • Markup (%)
  • Custom Metal Formula Builder
    • Create your own metal variables (e.g., Platinum, Rose Gold).
    • Define formulas like platinum = goldrate * 1.25.
    • Delete or edit them anytime.
  • Smart Calculation Formula
    Final Price = ((Metal Rate × Weight) + Base Price)
  • Wastage + Making Charge + Markup

* Fully compatible with simple and variable products.
* Integrates natively with WooCommerce — taxes, discounts, and shipping all apply normally.
* Auto-detects your store currency symbol.

🧮 Example Calculation

Given:
– Metal Rate = 85.50
– Weight = 10 g
– Wastage = 2%
– Making Charge = 5.00 (per g)
– Markup = 10%

Step-by-step:
Base = 85.50 × 10 = 855.00
After Wastage = 855.00 + (855 × 0.02) = 872.10
After Making = 872.10 + (5 × 10) = 922.10
Final = 922.10 + (922.10 × 0.10) = 1,014.31

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it through Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Go to Metal Prices under the WordPress Admin Menu.
  4. Enter today’s gold and silver rates.
  5. Optionally define custom metals and formulas.
  6. Edit a product → General Tab → select metal type, weight, and markup.
sections.faq:
Does it support WooCommerce taxes and shipping?

Yes. The plugin integrates directly with WooCommerce’s native pricing engine.

Can I define custom metal types?

Yes. Use the “Add Custom Metal” option in the admin panel to define your own rates and formulas.

Can I remove metals I added?

Yes. Each custom metal entry includes a delete option for easy cleanup.

Does it work with variable products?

Absolutely. Each variation is calculated independently.

Can I modify the karat percentage formulas?

Yes. Admins can adjust the percentage multipliers for 22K, 20K, and 18K gold in the settings.
